notes: Swoon (swooneditions.com) is a furniture/homeware retailer (Magento 2 backend, React SPA storefront). Reused the access route from the prior Home-Decor pass (notes/49.md): the site exposes an unauthenticated GraphQL endpoint at https://www.swooneditions.com/graphql which is the site's own data layer, no proxy/impersonation needed. Ran `{categories(pageSize:400,currentPage:N,filters:{})}` paged across 3 pages to retrieve the full category tree (1117 nodes total, matching the prior pass's count of 1114 +/- new/removed nodes), and grepped every category `name` for pet/dog/cat/puppy/kitten/paw keywords. No genuine pet-related category exists. The only substring hits were false positives: product range names 'Petherwin Range', 'Petersham Range', 'Petworth Range' (id 1133/1522/1691, matching 'pet' inside the word), plus 'Catalan Range' matching 'cat'. Cross-checked against the full sitemap.xml (5530 URLs): grepped for pet/dog/cat/puppy/kitten again, all 41 matches were the same false positives (Petersham/Petworth/Catalan product names, or 'petrol blue' colour variant in sofa titles). No nav section, mega-menu branch, or PDP naming for pets, dog beds, cat products, pet bowls, pet toys, leashes, crates, litter, or any Tier 1/Tier 2 Pet Care signal from the brief. Site is furniture-led (sofas, beds, wardrobes, tables, lighting, mirrors, rugs) with zero pet-specific merchandising. Absence proof: exhaustive category-tree enumeration (not just site search) plus sitemap cross-check, per brief section 4.
